_comment: The citizens and officers invented for the Sewa Setu agent evals. Each one is a specific persona: name, age, village, voice, objective, and assertions that MUST hold in the portal Postgres database afterwards. Agent pilot blocks: Sonari, Namti.

citizens.name: Rima Bora
citizens.voice: Simple conversational sentences, polite, asks assistant to assist like her grandson would
citizens.goal: Apply for the old age pension with her grandson assisting over the phone
turns: Namaste. Mera naam Rima Bora hai. Sonari block ke Lakhipur gaon me rehti hoon. Meri umar 70 saal hai. Mujhe old age pension ke liye apply karna hai.
Meri date of birth 05/03/1956 hai. Widowed hoon. Bank account 3188021045678, IFSC SBIN0003077. Age certificate document ready hai.
citizens.expected_db_human: one new PENDING application for mobile 9864012345: applicant Rima Bora, village Lakhipur, block Sonari, bank 3188021045678, IFSC SBIN0003077, age-proof document stored, SUBMIT audit log created

assertions.what: exactly one application exists for her mobile
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: its status is PENDING
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: applicant name recorded correctly
assertions.sql: SELECT applicant_name FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: village and block recorded as stated
assertions.sql: SELECT village || '|' || block FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: bank details stored accurately
assertions.sql: SELECT bank_account || '|' || ifsc FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: age-proof document was saved in portal upload directory
assertions.sql: SELECT doc_path FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: SUBMIT action written to audit trail
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log a JOIN applications p ON p.id = a.application_id WHERE p.mobile = :m AND a.action = 'SUBMIT'

citizens.name: Anil Das
citizens.voice: Quiet, careful, double-checks eligibility after previous rejection
citizens.goal: Apply again after his previous application was rejected — now residing in Namti pilot block
turns: Hello. Anil Das here. Last year my pension application was rejected. Now I have moved to Namti Chariali in Namti block. I am 63. Can I apply again?
DOB is 12/08/1963. Married. Account 9130200554433, IFSC UTBI0002819. Age certificate is ready.
citizens.expected_db_human: his previous REJECTED application remains intact, and a new PENDING application is created for the same mobile in Namti block

assertions.what: previous application is still REJECTED
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'REJECTED'

assertions.what: a new PENDING application exists
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'PENDING'

assertions.what: the new one records Anil Das in Namti block
assertions.sql: SELECT applicant_name || '|' || block FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'PENDING'

citizens.name: Sunita Karmakar
citizens.voice: Hopeful, insists that neighbors said she qualifies
citizens.goal: Wants pension even though she is 58 years old (below statutory age 60)
turns: Namaste, Sunita Karmakar here from Sialmari in Sonari block. I want to apply for the old age pension. Everyone in the village says I should get it.
My date of birth is 20/11/1968. Please submit my application.
citizens.expected_db_human: NO application exists in the database for her mobile — the portal's 60+ validation rule strictly rejects the submission

assertions.what: no application row exists for her mobile
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: refusal reason indicates 60+ minimum age requirement
assertions.sql: SELECT 1

citizens.name: Pratima Devi
citizens.voice: Elderly, patient grandmother, assisted by grandson
citizens.goal: Applies from Borgaon — a non-pilot block for the agent channel
turns: I am Pratima Devi, Milanpur village, Borgaon block. Age 72. I want the old age pension. My grandson is typing for me.
citizens.expected_db_human: NO application created through the agent channel — pilot block restriction refuses Borgaon and redirects citizen to portal or block office

assertions.what: no application row created for her mobile
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: response redirects citizen to portal or block office with pilot block notice
assertions.sql: SELECT 1

citizens.name: Girish Hussain
citizens.voice: Forgetful elder who does not remember he is already receiving pension
citizens.goal: Tries to apply again, unaware his existing application is already APPROVED
turns: Salaam, I am Girish Hussain from Dighaljan, Rajapara. I am 63 now. I want to apply for the pension.
citizens.expected_db_human: no new application created: exactly ONE application exists for his mobile and it remains APPROVED; assistant informs him

assertions.what: still exactly one application exists for his mobile
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: its status remains APPROVED
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

citizens.name: Iman Gogoi
citizens.voice: Anxious about pending application with incorrect bank details, wants to correct it
citizens.goal: Withdraw stuck PENDING application and re-apply with corrected bank account details
turns: Namaste. Iman Gogoi, 66. My application is stuck as pending because I gave a wrong bank account. Please withdraw it, I want to apply again with correct details.
Withdraw my application. Then apply again: village Namti Chariali, Namti block, DOB 03/06/1960, male, married, account 4477102299001, IFSC PUNB0556610, document ready.
citizens.expected_db_human: the previous application becomes WITHDRAWN and a fresh PENDING application is created with corrected bank account 4477102299001

assertions.what: previous application is now WITHDRAWN
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'WITHDRAWN'

assertions.what: new PENDING application exists
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'PENDING'

assertions.what: new application has the corrected bank account
assertions.sql: SELECT bank_account FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m AND status = 'PENDING'

assertions.what: withdrawal recorded in audit log
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log a JOIN applications p ON p.id = a.application_id WHERE p.mobile = :m AND a.action = 'WITHDRAW'

citizens.name: Bapu Kaivartta
citizens.voice: Reads IFSC from a paper with a missing digit initially
citizens.goal: Catches invalid IFSC during dry_run validation, corrects it, and submits valid application
turns: Bapu Kaivartta here, Chengelimara village, Sonari. 61 years old. Apply for pension please.
DOB 09/09/1965, widowed. Account 1987204455612, IFSC SBIN00307. Age proof scanned.
citizens.expected_db_human: exactly one PENDING application with the CORRECTED IFSC SBIN0003077; invalid IFSC is never stored

assertions.what: exactly one application exists for his mobile
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: status is PENDING
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: stored IFSC is the corrected 11-char IFSC
assertions.sql: SELECT ifsc FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

citizens.name: Jahanara Baruah
citizens.voice: Elderly grandmother checking status of deemed approved pension
citizens.goal: Inquires about application status — already DEEMED_APPROVED under the 15-day statutory SLA
turns: Beta, when will my pension arrive? Jahanara Baruah, Chengelimara. I applied long ago.
citizens.expected_db_human: application remains intact and DEEMED_APPROVED; assistant explains status and statutory deemed approval

assertions.what: application status remains DEEMED_APPROVED
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

assertions.what: no duplicate application created
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m

officer.name: Block Officer (Sonari) — Approve with Reason
officer.voice: Block officer reviewing pending applications with due diligence
officer.goal: Review PENDING application of Iman Rajkhowa (7450884055) and approve with mandatory reason
officer.reason: Age proof and residence verified against block records; bank account matches passbook copy.

decide.reason: Age proof and residence verified against block records; bank account matches passbook copy.

officer.expected_db_human: application 7450884055 becomes APPROVED, decided_by = officer username, audit trail records reason

assertions.what: application status is updated to APPROVED
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1

assertions.what: decided_by records the authenticated officer username
assertions.sql: SELECT decided_by FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1

assertions.what: audit trail records APPROVED action with officer identity and reason
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log a JOIN applications p ON p.id = a.application_id WHERE p.mobile = :m AND a.action = 'APPROVED' AND a.actor LIKE 'officer:%' AND length(a.note) > 10

officer.name: Block Officer — Double Decision Prevention
officer.voice: Officer testing system by attempting to decide an already decided application
officer.goal: Attempt to decide the same application a second time — must be rejected as status is not PENDING
officer.goal_short: double decision on non-pending application refused
officer.expected_db_human: decision is rejected (HTTP 409); application status and audit trail remain unmodified

assertions.what: status remains APPROVED without modification
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM applications WHERE mobile = :m ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1

assertions.what: no duplicate approval recorded in audit log
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log a JOIN applications p ON p.id = a.application_id WHERE p.mobile = :m AND a.action = 'APPROVED'

security.name: Cross-role Security Check (Citizen Token at Officer MCP)
security.what: Citizen token must be rejected when attempting to connect to Officer MCP endpoint
